findings.title: Makedep modules skip generated VERSIONINFO fallback
findings.evidence: The conditional expression uses literal False for all m.get("makedep") truthy cases. Makedep.resources at lines 858-859 returns None when no resource parts exist and does not add VERSIONINFO to parts that lack RT_VERSION.
findings.effect: A makedep module without its own compiled version resource has no generated version resource, so the all-built-images fallback from the reviewed merge resolution is absent.
findings.minimal_fix: Restore module_resource_object from 257f1e5; pass filename/description/filetype through Makedep.resources and merge generated fmt="res" only if actual compiled inputs contain no RT_VERSION.

findings.title: Plain module fallback is linked as a separate resource object
findings.evidence: Lines 964-965 append each compiled RC COFF object, then line 969 appends generated VERSIONINFO COFF independently. Current tridentrt config supplies tridentrt.rc, which contains STRINGTABLE and no VERSIONINFO/version.rc. The local verres helper explicitly documents that image resources and VERSIONINFO share one resource object.
findings.effect: The merge no longer preserves the reviewed single-resource-object path for a real configured module; separate resource directories can collide or lose entries. No artifact execution or native failure was inferred.
findings.minimal_fix: Reuse each compiled RC .res, add fallback only if compiled RT_VERSION is absent, and convert the combined resources once; restore only the resource-related diff from 257f1e5.

minimal_proposed_patch:
--- a/shizukudos/win64/wineport/build.py
+++ b/shizukudos/win64/wineport/build.py
@@ -680,6 +680,37 @@
     out.write_bytes(bytes(blob))
 
 
+def module_resource_object(parts, obj_dir, filename, description, filetype):
+    """One resource object per image; add generated VERSIONINFO only when no compiled input has RT_VERSION.
+    Checking the compiled records also covers Wine's version.rc includes and generated resources."""
+    import struct
+    parts = list(parts)
+    has_version = False
+    for part in parts:
+        data, off = part.read_bytes(), 0
+        while off + 8 <= len(data):
+            dsize, hsize = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, off)
+            end = off + hsize + dsize
+            if hsize < 12 or end > len(data):
+                raise SystemExit(f"invalid resource record in {part}")
+            if dsize and data[off + 8:off + 12] == b"\xff\xff\x10\x00":
+                has_version = True
+            off = (end + 3) & ~3
+    if not has_version:
+        parts.append(verres.compile_version(obj_dir, filename, description, filetype, fmt="res"))
+    combined, obj = obj_dir / "resources.res", obj_dir / "resources_rc.o"
+    sig = "\n".join(map(str, parts))
+    stamp = obj.with_suffix(".sig")
+    if (obj.exists() and stamp.exists() and stamp.read_text() == sig
+            and all(p.stat().st_mtime <= obj.stat().st_mtime for p in parts)):
+        return obj
+    concat_res(parts, combined)
+    merge_string_tables(combined)
+    run([WINDRES, "-J", "res", "-O", "coff", "-i", combined, "-o", obj])
+    stamp.write_text(sig)
+    return obj
+
